af/hint_02.text: Hier is 'n leidraad. Soek die een wat wikkel!

af/hint_02_big.text: Hier is 'n leidraad: kyk na die een wat wikkel.

af/hint_03_big.text: Kom ons hoor dit nog een keer:

af/praise_08.text: Bip is so trots op jou!

af/vo_art_island.text: Welkom op Kuns-eiland! Kom ons speel met vorms, verf en spieëls.

af/vo_art_island_big.text: Kuns-eiland: vorms, verf en spieëls. Klik op Bip om te begin.

af/vo_balance.text: Laat die wipplank aan albei kante ewe swaar wees!

af/vo_balance_helps.text: Daardie een help met hierdie een.

af/vo_bip_charging.text: Bip se battery is pap, so hy rus 'n bietjie. Wanneer die battery vol is, kan ons weer speel!

af/vo_bip_charging_big.text: Bip se battery is pap, so hy laai op. Tyd vir 'n blaaskans. Ons speel weer wanneer hy vol is.

af/vo_bips_day.text: Wat doen Bip? Luister na die Engels, en soek dan die prentjie.

af/vo_bips_path.text: Las die pyle aan mekaar, en druk dan Gaan om Bip huis toe te stap.

af/vo_bips_stories.text: Hier is 'n storie. Luister, en klik op 'n sin om dit weer te hoor. Klik op die groen pyl om die bladsy om te blaai.

af/vo_build_word.text: Sleep die letters om die woord in die prentjie te bou.

af/vo_click_to_hear_again.text: Klik op die letter om dit weer te hoor. Klik op die groen pyl as jy gereed is.

af/vo_coding_island.text: Welkom op Kodeer-eiland! Klik op Bip, dan programmeer ons.

af/vo_coding_island_big.text: Kodeer-eiland. Klik op Bip om te begin programmeer.

af/vo_count_in_steps.text: Kom ons tel in stappe van

af/vo_count_tap.text: Tik elkeen terwyl ons tel, en tik dan die getal.

af/vo_day_done.text: Dis al vir vandag se speel. Sien jou môre!

af/vo_day_done_big.text: Dis al vir vandag. Goeie werk. Sien jou môre!

af/vo_feed_monster.text: Voer die monster net kos wat begin met…

af/vo_find_the_sound.text: Vind die prentjie wat begin met…

af/vo_find_tower.text: Kan jy die toring kry van

af/vo_groups_of.text: Pak die kos in groepe van

af/vo_island_sleeping.text: Daardie eiland slaap nog. Kom ons speel op Letter-eiland!

af/vo_island_sleeping_big.text: Daardie eiland is nog nie gereed nie. Probeer Letter-eiland!

af/vo_language_island.text: Welkom op Taal-eiland! Kom ons leer saam 'n paar Engelse woorde.

af/vo_language_island_big.text: Taal-eiland. Kom ons leer 'n bietjie Engels.

af/vo_laundry_3.text: Hang dit op om droog te word

af/vo_lets_practise_again.text: Kom ons oefen daardie klank weer saam.

af/vo_lets_practise_again_big.text: Kom ons oefen dié een nog 'n bietjie.

af/vo_letters_island.text: Welkom op Letter-eiland! Klik op Bip, dan speel ons.

af/vo_letters_island_big.text: Letter-eiland. Klik op Bip as jy gereed is.

af/vo_level_up.text: Sjoe! Jy ken daardie klank nou regtig goed!

af/vo_level_up_big.text: Jy ken dié een nou regtig goed. Op na die volgende vlak!

af/vo_machine_in.text: Wat het in die masjien ingegaan?

af/vo_machine_out.text: Wat kom uit die masjien uit?

af/vo_machine_rule.text: Wat doen die masjien? Soek sy kaart.

af/vo_make_ten.text: Sit blokke by om tien te maak!

af/vo_mirror_finish.text: Watter stuk maak die prentjie klaar?

af/vo_mirror_line.text: Waar is die spieëllyn? Vind die lyn wat die prentjie in twee gelyke helftes vou.

af/vo_mirror_pegs.text: Sit penne aan die ander kant van die spieël om die patroon klaar te maak.

af/vo_mirror_same.text: Watter prentjie is aan albei kante dieselfde?

af/vo_morning_order.text: Sit die prentjies in die regte volgorde. Wat kom eerste?

af/vo_number_machine.text: Dit is Bip se getalmasjien! 'n Getal gaan in, en die masjien verander dit.

af/vo_numbers_island.text: Welkom op Getalle-eiland! Klik op Bip, dan tel ons.

af/vo_numbers_island_big.text: Getalle-eiland. Klik op Bip om te begin tel.

af/vo_one_each.text: Kom ons gee een vir elke bord, rond en rond.

af/vo_paint_predict.text: Watter kleur sal hierdie twee maak?

af/vo_picnic.text: Bip hou 'n piekniek! Help hom om die kos op die borde te sit.

af/vo_round_done.text: Mooi gespeel! Kom ons gaan terug na die eiland.

af/vo_round_done_big.text: Goeie rondte. Kom ons gaan terug na die eiland.

af/vo_sent_12.text: Die maan is in die see.

af/vo_sent_16.text: Die vink is in my hemp.

af/vo_shape_count_turns.text: Kyk hoe die vorm heeltemal om draai. Hoeveel keer lyk dit dieselfde?

af/vo_shape_regular.text: Watter vorm se kante is almal ewe lank?

af/vo_shape_turn.text: Kyk hoe die vorms draai. Watter een lyk steeds dieselfde?

af/vo_show_me.text: Luister na die Engelse woord, en klik dan op die prentjie.

af/vo_sound_buttons.text: Druk elke knoppie, en vind dan die woord wat hulle maak.

af/vo_story_bal_in_die_boom_1.text: Ruan en Thabo skop die bal.

af/vo_story_bal_in_die_boom_2.text: Die bal sit vas in 'n boom.

af/vo_story_bal_in_die_boom_3.text: Pa haal die bal met 'n leer af.

af/vo_story_die_groot_wedstryd_1.text: Dis Saterdag en die span speel sokker.

af/vo_story_die_groot_wedstryd_2.text: Nandi, Thabo en Ruan is gereed.

af/vo_story_die_groot_wedstryd_3.text: Thabo val en sy knie bloei.

af/vo_story_die_groot_wedstryd_4.text: Die afrigter help hom na die bank.

af/vo_story_die_groot_wedstryd_6.text: Sy hardloop so vinnig as wat sy kan.

af/vo_story_die_groot_wedstryd_8.text: Almal juig, ook Thabo op die bank.

af/vo_story_die_groot_wedstryd_q2.text: Hoekom sit Thabo op die bank?

af/vo_story_die_groot_wedstryd_q3.text: Wat doen almal aan die einde?

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_1.text: Pieter se pa het 'n paar ou planke.

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_2.text: Saam saag hulle die planke kort.

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_3.text: Pieter slaan die spykers met die hamer in.

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_5.text: Pa klim op die leer en hang die kassie in die boom.

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_6.text: Na 'n week bou twee voëls 'n nes in die kassie.

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_7.text: Pieter kyk elke dag na hulle.

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_a4.text: Om die kassie in die boom te hang.

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_q1.text: Waarmee slaan Pieter die spykers in?

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_q2.text: Hoekom klim Pa op die leer?

af/vo_story_die_neskassie_q3.text: Wie bou 'n nes in die kassie?

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_1.text: Meneer Smit kies Kabelo om in die skoolkonsert die trom te speel.

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_2.text: Elke middag oefen hy agter in die tuin.

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_3.text: Die kat skrik en hardloop weg.

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_4.text: Op die aand van die konsert bewe Kabelo se hande.

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_5.text: Ouma sê saggies: "Luister net na die musiek."

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_6.text: Die gordyn gaan oop en die koor begin sing.

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_7.text: Kabelo laat 'n stokkie val, maar hy speel met sy hand verder.

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_8.text: Aan die einde klap almal hande.

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_q1.text: Wie sê Kabelo moet net na die musiek luister?

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_q2.text: Hoe voel Kabelo aan die einde?

af/vo_story_die_skoolkonsert_q3.text: Hoekom speel Kabelo met sy hand?

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_1.text: Graad 4 gaan strand toe, maar oral lê blikkies en plastieksakke.

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_2.text: Juffrou Mokoena deel handskoene en vullissakke uit.

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_3.text: Agter 'n rots kry Pieter 'n krap wat in 'n ou visnet vasgedraai is.

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_4.text: Saggies trek Zara en Pieter die net los.

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_5.text: Die krap skarrel terug see toe.

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_6.text: Teen middagete het die klas twaalf groot sakke vol.

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_7.text: Terug by die skool maak hulle 'n plakkaat: "Hou ons strand skoon!"

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_a7.text: Sodat almal die strand skoon hou.

af/vo_story_die_strand_word_skoon_q1.text: Hoe voel Zara toe die krap terug see toe skarrel?

af/vo_story_lina_se_verrassing_1.text: Vandag word Lina agt, maar Pa sê niks by die ontbyttafel nie.

af/vo_story_lina_se_verrassing_3.text: Met haar sak op die rug stap sy skool toe.

af/vo_story_lina_se_verrassing_4.text: Sy maak die klasdeur oop en almal skree: "Verras!"

af/vo_story_lina_se_verrassing_6.text: Na skool wag Pa by die huis met 'n hondjie.

af/vo_story_lina_se_verrassing_7.text: Hy het die geheim die hele dag gehou!

af/vo_story_lina_se_verrassing_q2.text: Hoekom sê Pa niks by die ontbyttafel nie?

af/vo_story_look_again.text: Kom ons kyk weer na hierdie deel van die storie.

af/vo_story_markdag_1.text: Saterdagoggend stap Ma en Kabelo mark toe.

af/vo_story_markdag_2.text: Daar is appels, piesangs en pruime.

af/vo_story_markdag_5.text: By die huis bak Ma 'n appeltert.

af/vo_story_markdag_q3.text: Wat bak Ma by die huis?

af/vo_story_mia_se_koek_1.text: Ouma en Mia klits eiers in 'n bak.

af/vo_story_modderhond_1.text: Die hond is in die modder.

af/vo_story_modderhond_2.text: Ma was die hond by die kraan.

af/vo_story_nandi_se_sak_2.text: 'n Pop en 'n koppie is in die sak.

af/vo_story_nandi_se_sak_q1.text: Wat is in die sak saam met die koppie?

af/vo_story_ouma_se_tuin_1.text: Zara en Ouma plant sade in die tuin.

af/vo_story_ouma_se_tuin_2.text: Hulle gee die sade water met 'n beker.

af/vo_story_ouma_se_tuin_3.text: Die aand reën dit sag op die tuin.

af/vo_story_ouma_se_tuin_4.text: 'n Week later is daar klein groen plantjies!

af/vo_story_oupa_se_bootjie_1.text: Oupa en Ruan stoot die bootjie in die water.

af/vo_story_oupa_se_bootjie_2.text: Ruan het sy net by hom.

af/vo_story_oupa_se_bootjie_4.text: Ruan gooi sy net uit en vang twee visse.

af/vo_story_oupa_se_bootjie_5.text: Op die strand kry hulle 'n krap.

af/vo_story_oupa_se_bootjie_6.text: Hulle sit die krap terug in die water.

af/vo_story_padda_op_die_stomp_2.text: Die eend kom op die stomp.

af/vo_story_padda_op_die_stomp_q1.text: Wie sit eerste op die stomp?

af/vo_story_pannekoek_1.text: Pa, Mia en Kabelo bak pannekoek.

af/vo_story_pannekoek_2.text: In die bak gaan eiers, melk en meel.

af/vo_story_pannekoek_3.text: Die pan word warm op die stoof.

af/vo_story_pannekoek_4.text: Mia gooi die eerste pannekoek in.

af/vo_story_pannekoek_5.text: Kabelo speel met die hond en vergeet van die pan.

af/vo_story_pannekoek_6.text: Die pannekoek brand en die kombuis is vol rook!

af/vo_story_pannekoek_a4.text: Kabelo het van die pan vergeet.

af/vo_story_questions.text: Luister nou na die vraag, en klik dan op die antwoord.

af/vo_story_slakke_soek_1.text: Juffrou Botha lees vir die klas 'n storie oor slakke.

af/vo_story_slakke_soek_2.text: Buite in die tuin soek die kinders slakke.

af/vo_story_slakke_soek_4.text: In die klas teken hulle die slak met potlode.

af/vo_story_slakke_soek_q2.text: Wat soek die kinders in die tuin?

af/vo_story_slakke_soek_q3.text: Wat doen hulle in die klas?

af/vo_story_slang_op_die_paadjie_1.text: Mia en haar boet Pieter pak hoede, water en toebroodjies vir 'n staptog.

af/vo_story_slang_op_die_paadjie_2.text: Saam met Pa klim hulle die bergpaadjie uit.

af/vo_story_slang_op_die_paadjie_3.text: Skielik staan Pa stil. 'n Slang lê oor die paadjie!

af/vo_story_slang_op_die_paadjie_5.text: Na 'n rukkie gly die slang weg in die gras in.

af/vo_story_slang_op_die_paadjie_6.text: Bo-op die berg eet hulle hul toebroodjies en kyk na die see ver onder.

af/vo_story_slang_op_die_paadjie_7.text: "Daardie slang was seker banger as ons," lag Pieter.

af/vo_story_slang_op_die_paadjie_a4.text: Daar lê 'n slang op die paadjie.

af/vo_story_slang_op_die_paadjie_q3.text: Hoe voel Pieter bo-op die berg?

af/vo_story_thabo_se_bus_1.text: Pa en Thabo sit op die bank.

af/vo_story_thabo_se_bus_5.text: Sy boek is op die tafel.

af/vo_story_thabo_se_bus_q2.text: Waar is Thabo aan die einde?

af/vo_story_vlieer_en_reen_1.text: Nandi en Zara speel met 'n vlieër.

af/vo_story_vlieer_en_reen_q1.text: Wat gebeur toe die wolke kom?

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_1.text: Elke Sondag stap Thabo en sy hond, Wagter, op die strand.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_2.text: Skielik sien Wagter 'n seemeeu en hardloop agterna.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_3.text: Thabo roep en roep, maar Wagter luister nie.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_4.text: Thabo soek agter elke rots, maar hy kry hom nêrens nie.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_5.text: Donker wolke trek oor die see en dit begin reën.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_6.text: By die strandwag se hut hoor hy 'n bekende blaf.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_7.text: Die strandwag hou vir Wagter vas.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_8.text: Tuis slaap Wagter op die mat.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_9.text: Van nou af bly hy aan sy leiband.

af/vo_story_wagter_hardloop_weg_q1.text: Hoe voel Thabo toe hy Wagter nie kan kry nie?

vo_story_beach_clean_up_1.text: When Grade 4 visits the beach, Aisha sees cans and plastic bags everywhere.

vo_story_beach_clean_up_2.text: Ms Mokoena hands out gloves and rubbish bags.

vo_story_beach_clean_up_3.text: "Let's clean up our beach," she says.

vo_story_beach_clean_up_4.text: Behind a rock, Jack finds a crab caught in an old fishing net.

vo_story_beach_clean_up_5.text: Very gently, Aisha and Jack pull the net away.

vo_story_beach_clean_up_6.text: The crab scuttles back to the sea.

vo_story_beach_clean_up_7.text: By lunchtime, the class has filled twelve big bags.

vo_story_beach_clean_up_8.text: Back at school, they paint a poster: "Keep our beach clean!"

vo_story_beach_clean_up_q1.text: What did Jack find behind a rock?

vo_story_beach_clean_up_q2.text: Why did the class pick up the rubbish?

vo_story_beach_clean_up_q3.text: How do you think the children felt at the end?

vo_story_bus_to_school_1.text: Sipho and Dad sit on a bench.

vo_story_bus_to_school_5.text: His book is on the desk.

vo_story_crab_on_a_rock_2.text: It can run to the sea.

vo_story_crab_on_a_rock_q1.text: What did the crab sit on?

vo_story_emmas_cake_2.text: Then they bake a big cake.

vo_story_emmas_cake_q2.text: What do they mix in the bowl?

vo_story_frog_on_a_log_2.text: Then a duck sat on the log.

vo_story_gogos_garden_1.text: Aisha and Gogo plant seeds in the garden.

vo_story_gogos_garden_2.text: They water them with a jug.

vo_story_gogos_garden_3.text: That night, rain falls on the garden.

vo_story_gogos_garden_4.text: A week later, little green plants pop up!

vo_story_gogos_garden_5.text: Gogo gives Aisha a big hug.

vo_story_gogos_garden_q2.text: What did they water the seeds with?

vo_story_gogos_garden_q3.text: What came up a week later?

vo_story_grandpas_boat_4.text: Kyle catches two fish in his net.

vo_story_grandpas_boat_5.text: Back on the beach, they find a crab.

vo_story_grandpas_boat_6.text: They let the crab go, and take the fish home.

vo_story_grandpas_boat_q1.text: Who went in the boat with Kyle?

vo_story_grandpas_boat_q2.text: What did Kyle catch in his net?

vo_story_market_day_1.text: On Saturday, Mum and Tumi go to the market.

vo_story_market_day_2.text: There are apples, bananas and plums.

vo_story_market_day_4.text: He pays with a big coin.

vo_story_market_day_5.text: At home, Mum bakes a pie.

vo_story_market_day_6.text: Tumi has a banana while he waits.

vo_story_market_day_q1.text: Where did Mum and Tumi go?

vo_story_market_day_q3.text: What did Mum bake at home?

vo_story_muddy_dog_2.text: Mum has the dog at the tap.

vo_story_pancake_morning_1.text: Emma and her friend Tumi help Dad make pancakes.

vo_story_pancake_morning_2.text: They mix eggs, milk and flour in a bowl.

vo_story_pancake_morning_3.text: Dad heats the pan on the stove.

vo_story_pancake_morning_4.text: Emma pours in the first pancake. Sizzle!

vo_story_pancake_morning_5.text: Tumi plays with the dog and forgets to flip it.

vo_story_pancake_morning_6.text: Oh no, it burns, and smoke fills the kitchen!

vo_story_pancake_morning_7.text: The next pancakes are just right.

vo_story_pancake_morning_q1.text: What did they mix in the bowl?

vo_story_pancake_morning_q2.text: Why did the first pancake burn?

vo_story_pancake_morning_q3.text: What did they eat the pancakes with?

vo_story_priyas_birthday_1.text: It is Priya's eighth birthday, but at breakfast Dad says nothing.

vo_story_priyas_birthday_3.text: She walks to school slowly with her bag.

vo_story_priyas_birthday_4.text: When she opens the classroom door, everyone shouts, "Surprise!"

vo_story_priyas_birthday_5.text: Her teacher has a big chocolate cake.

vo_story_priyas_birthday_6.text: After school, Dad has a present for her: a puppy!

vo_story_priyas_birthday_7.text: He was keeping the secret all day.

vo_story_priyas_birthday_a1.text: Dad said nothing about her birthday.

vo_story_priyas_birthday_q1.text: Why was Priya quiet at breakfast?

vo_story_questions.text: Now listen to the question, then click on the answer.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_1.text: Every Sunday, Sipho walks his dog, Rocky, along the beach.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_10.text: Next time, Sipho will keep him on his lead.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_2.text: Today Rocky sees a seagull and races off after it.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_3.text: Sipho shouts, but Rocky doesn't stop.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_6.text: Dark clouds roll in from the sea, and it starts to rain.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_7.text: Then he hears barking near the lifeguard hut.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_8.text: A lifeguard is holding Rocky! "He was waiting for you," she says.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_9.text: At home, Rocky falls asleep on the rug.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_a2.text: He was scared of the rain.

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_q2.text: How did Sipho feel when he couldn't find Rocky?

vo_story_rocky_runs_off_q3.text: Where was Rocky in the end?

vo_story_snail_hunt_1.text: In Grade 2, Mrs Dlamini reads the class a book about snails.

vo_story_snail_hunt_2.text: Then the children look for snails in the school garden.

vo_story_snail_hunt_3.text: Priya finds one on a leaf.

vo_story_snail_hunt_4.text: Back in class, they draw the snail with pencils.

vo_story_snail_hunt_q2.text: Where did Priya find the snail?

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_1.text: Emma and her brother Jack pack hats, water and sandwiches for a hike.

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_2.text: They follow the path up the hill with Dad.

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_3.text: Suddenly Dad stops. A snake is lying across the path!

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_4.text: "Stand still and stay calm," he says quietly.

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_5.text: After a while, the snake slides away into the grass.

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_6.text: At the top, they eat their sandwiches and look at the sea far below.

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_7.text: Jack laughs, "I think that snake was more scared of us than we were of it!"

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_a1.text: A snake was lying across it.

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_q1.text: Why did Dad stop on the path?

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_q2.text: How did the children feel when they saw the snake?

vo_story_snake_on_the_path_q3.text: What did they eat at the top?

vo_story_thandis_bag_2.text: The bag has a doll and a cup.

vo_story_thandis_bag_q1.text: What is in the bag with the doll?

vo_story_the_big_match_1.text: It is the last soccer match of the term.

vo_story_the_big_match_2.text: Thandi, Sipho and Kyle play for the Blue Team.

vo_story_the_big_match_3.text: Sipho falls and hurts his knee.

vo_story_the_big_match_4.text: Coach Peters helps him to the bench.

vo_story_the_big_match_5.text: Now Thandi must play up front.

vo_story_the_big_match_6.text: She runs fast and kicks the ball hard.

vo_story_the_big_match_8.text: Sipho cheers from the bench with a plaster on his knee.

vo_story_the_big_match_q2.text: Why did Sipho sit on the bench?

vo_story_the_nest_box_1.text: Jack wants to help the birds in his garden.

vo_story_the_nest_box_2.text: He and his dad cut old planks with a saw.

vo_story_the_nest_box_3.text: Jack hammers in the nails carefully.

vo_story_the_nest_box_4.text: Soon they have a little wooden box with a round hole.

vo_story_the_nest_box_5.text: Dad climbs the ladder and hangs the box in the tree.

vo_story_the_nest_box_6.text: A week later, two birds build a nest inside.

vo_story_the_nest_box_q1.text: What did Jack and his dad make?

vo_story_the_nest_box_q2.text: Why did Jack make the box?

vo_story_the_nest_box_q3.text: Where did Dad hang the box?

vo_story_the_school_concert_1.text: Mr Naidoo chooses Tumi to play the drum in the school concert.

vo_story_the_school_concert_10.text: Tumi smiles from ear to ear.

vo_story_the_school_concert_2.text: Every afternoon Tumi practises in the garden. Boom, boom, boom!

vo_story_the_school_concert_4.text: On the night of the concert, Tumi's hands are shaking.

vo_story_the_school_concert_5.text: Gran whispers, "Just listen to the music."

vo_story_the_school_concert_6.text: The curtain opens and the choir starts to sing.

vo_story_the_school_concert_7.text: Halfway through, Tumi drops a drumstick!

vo_story_the_school_concert_8.text: He keeps the beat with his hand.

vo_story_the_school_concert_9.text: At the end, everyone claps and cheers.

vo_story_the_school_concert_q1.text: How did Tumi feel before the concert started?

vo_story_the_school_concert_q3.text: Why did the cat run away?
